# Release notes

Extension SQL version stays at 1.10. No storage or WAL format changes.

Query correctness:
- `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE` no longer silently skips the row, returning and changing nothing, when the row holds a committed foreign key lock whose undo has already been passed by a checkpoint or by time (0f168a69)

Full Changelog: https://github.com/orioledb/orioledb/compare/v1.10.2...v1.10.3

Release v1.10.1 mistakenly did not update `ORIOLEDB_VERSION`. This release fixes it by setting new correct version to `ORIOLEDB_VERSION`.
- Moving a database to another tablespace on a physical standby now works correctly (73c99add)
- Fixed the default value of `orioledb.rewind_max_transactions` (ba092c6f)
Full Changelog: https://github.com/orioledb/orioledb/compare/v1.10.1...v1.10.2

- The empty orioledb_data/<dbOid> directory is removed after DROP DATABASE (01e9d660)
Starting with this release, OrioleDB uses `v<major>.<minor>.<patch>` release numbers (e.g. `v1.10.1`) instead of `betaN`. Release branches are named after the SQL version (`v1.10`), and only the most recent release branch is supported and receives backpatched fixes.

- Segfault in CREATE DATABASE ... TEMPLATE with enum-indexed columns (3424e8a7, 6c063455, fbb28d32)
Full Changelog: https://github.com/orioledb/orioledb/compare/beta18...beta19

- orioledb_tbl_structure() no longer prints fixed-length by-reference values as "TOASTed" (74603e7d)

## [0.2.8] - 2026-11-21

### Added

- **Authorize SSH keys for linked clients** — new `authorize_keys` API token
  permission (works together with Read only) and
  `POST`/`DELETE /api/servers/:id/authorize-key`. A client such as
  [sshya](https://github.com/Ceneka/sshya) sends its own public key and
  LazyBackup adds it to the server's `~/.ssh/authorized_keys` with the stored
  credentials, so keys generated inside LazyBackup stay inside it. Each call is
  audited with the key fingerprint.
